artworks.title: L.F. Raymond Wolowski
artworks.description: The illustration shows a man standing, characterized by a stylized head with exaggerated features. He has a neutral expression, short hair, and is dressed in formal attire with a hat that has feathers. In the background, there is a podium-like structure with a smaller figure leaning on it.

artworks.title: Adolphe Thiers
artworks.description: The man in this print is standing upright, partially turned to the left, with his hands behind his back. He has pale skin, a long nose, round cheeks, and a hint of a smile on his thin lips. He has short, neatly combed white hair and arched dark eyebrows, and he wears small round spectacles. The man is dressed in formal attire, including a long light-colored coat, a white waistcoat, trousers, and dark boots, with a high-collared shirt. He is holding a rolled object behind his back, like a rolled piece of paper. The background is plain, and the man casts a dark shadow on the blank ground.

artworks.title: J. Antoine Taschereau
artworks.description: The image depicts a caricature of an elderly man walking in profile facing to the right. His head is exaggeratedly large compared to his body, with pronounced facial features such as a large nose and prominent chin. He has a full head of hair, styled with a slight wave, and sports a beard and mustache. The man is wearing a long coat, trousers, and shoes, and is holding a piece of paper or an envelope. The background is plain, with light shading around the subject for depth, but no specific objects or scenery are shown.

artworks.title: P.J. Proudhon
artworks.description: The image shows a caricature of a person standing upright. The individual has a large head with distinct facial features, wearing round glasses and short, wavy hair. They are dressed in a bulky coat and baggy trousers, with arms crossed over their chest. A halo-like object is drawn above their head. Near their feet is an open book with text, and two rats are nearby. The background is plain with line shading on the floor.

artworks.title: Jules Bastide
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing behind a podium with his hands resting on it. He has a large head with expressive features, including thick eyebrows, a long nose, and an open mouth. He has short dark hair and is wearing a buttoned-up jacket with a high collar. The podium has a decorative design with a circular wreath. In the background, there are shaded areas suggesting part of an interior space. A small cup or glass sits on a tray on the left corner of the podium.

artworks.title: J. Alexandre Bixio
artworks.description: The image shows a caricature of a man standing. His exaggerated facial features include a prominent nose and an elongated face. He has short hair combed over, wearing a vest over a long-sleeved shirt and trousers. He holds a watering can in each hand, watering plants nearby. An open book with visible text lies on the ground. The background features sketched trees and shrubs, suggesting a garden setting.

artworks.title: C.H. Odilon Barrot
artworks.description: The image shows a caricature of a man standing on a pedestal. His exaggerated features include a large bald head with some hair at the sides, a prominent brow, and a stern expression. He is dressed in a suit, holding a book labeled "ÉCRIE." Smaller figures surround him, looking up. The background is simple, emphasizing the central figure.

artworks.title: Une Alliance
artworks.description: The image shows two figures engaged in a handshake. The person on the left is standing upright and facing right, wearing a pointed hat and a suit with vertical stripes. They have a neatly trimmed beard and curly hair, holding a book labeled "SCEPTICISME" under their arm. The person on the right is slightly bent backward with one arm raised, engaging in the handshake. They have long, tousled hair and a gaunt face, with loosely fitted clothing. A halo is above their head. The background has minimal detail, focusing on the two figures.

artworks.title: Vois-tu petit, t'as tort...
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals in a kitchen setting. On the right, a man is working with dough on a table. He wears a chef's uniform. On the left, a child in similar attire is standing on a stool, churning something in a container. The background is a sketchy depiction of a kitchen with cooking utensils and food items.

artworks.title: Ils prétendent qu'ils la soutiennent
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of caricatured figures interacting with a statue of a woman. Four figures with exaggerated facial features are energetically engaged around the statue, which sits atop a plinth marked with "République Française". The figures appear to be trying to either climb onto or pull at the base, and each figure is rendered with elongated and distorted proportions. The statue of the woman is depicted with classical features and draped attire, reminiscent of allegorical representations of republics or liberty, and holds a shield inscribed with the same "République Française". The setting appears to be humorous or critical in tone, likely commenting on political or social issues.

artworks.title: Dites donc, président, impossible d'attraper un lièvre...
artworks.description: The image features two men standing from just below the knee upwards. The man on the left is facing slightly towards the other man, with his body mostly turned to his side. The man on the right stands facing left with a slight turn of his body towards the viewer. The left man has a prominent nose, large eyes, neatly styled hair under a small cap, and is dressed in a dark jacket over a light shirt with vertical stripes and matching striped pants. The right man has a large chin, pronounced cheekbones, and his hair is covered by a wide-brimmed hat. He wears a loose-fitting shirt, pants, and a netted garment draped over his right shoulder, carrying a long object behind him. In the background, there is a lightly sketched landscape with a house on the left and sparse trees, while the drawing primarily focuses on the two foreground figures with minimal details in the background.

artworks.title: Clytemnestre poussée par mimi Véron...
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two shadowy figures with a scroll and a sleeping individual in the background. The scene depicts two figures in dark attire standing on the left, partially obscured by drapery. One is wearing a conical hat and patterned suit while the other, holding a cylindrical scroll or instrument, is pointing towards the right. On the right, beyond the curtains, is another figure reclining on a bed with a peaceful expression, surrounded by pillows and layered textiles. Above them, a small cluster of symbolic objects is mounted on the wall.

artworks.title: A.P.F. Deslongrais
artworks.description: The image shows a caricature of a man standing upright. He is holding a large fork with his right hand, while his left hand rests on a white table. The man's facial features are exaggerated, including a large head, pronounced cheekbones, and a pointed nose. He has curly hair and sideburns, and is dressed in formal attire. The background is simple, with soft lines suggesting curtains and a table with a vase-like object.

artworks.title: J. Marie-Anne Degousée
artworks.description: The image is a caricature showing a man standing in a slightly turned position. The man has a beard, unruly curly hair, and pronounced facial features with deep-set eyes, structured eyelids, and an expressive brow. He is dressed in formal attire and holding a tray with a small object on it in his right hand. The background is a simple, lightly shaded area.

artworks.title: Ferdinand Flocon
artworks.description: The image depicts a full-body caricature drawing of a person standing with their hands behind their back, holding a top hat. The person is facing forward, with a slightly turned head, exuding a prominent facial expression. Their face features exaggerated large eyes, facial lines, and a bushy mustache. The hair is long and flows down to their shoulders. The person is dressed in formal attire, consisting of a long, dark coat, a shirt, and a bow tie. The clothing appears to have a tailored look typical of formal wear. In the background, there is a faint sketch of seated people.

artworks.title: Ma femme est-elle a la maison?
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures interacting on a stairway. The image shows a person with a broom or mop standing at the bottom of a staircase, addressing another person who is ascending the stairs. The person on the stairs is dressed in a formal coat and top hat, gripping the handrail, and appears to be frowning or looking disgruntled. The person at the bottom appears to be wearing a headscarf and apron, and might be in a pose of speaking or calling out. The drawing is in black and white, with detailed shading to suggest volume and texture, capturing the moment between the two characters.

artworks.title: Mais quand je vous dis que je ne peux pas remuer les pieds...
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a domestic scene with two figures in an interior setting. The drawing depicts two men engaged in a conversation in a room. One man stands on the left holding a piece of cloth while the other faces him, gesturing. They are dressed in 19th-century attire. The room is furnished with a couch, and there are objects on the floor that resemble slippers or discarded items. The walls have two framed pictures and a decorative clock. The drawing is in a monochrome style using dark lines and shading for texture and depth. The focus is on the moment of interaction with expressive body language and the interior setting.

artworks.title: Inconvénient d'un parapluie a ressorts trop compliqués
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals walking closely together. The man is holding an open umbrella, while the woman is holding her dress with one hand and the man's arm or shoulder with the other. The man has distinct facial features and a top hat covering part of his hair. The woman has a bonnet covering most of her hair. The man is wearing a dark coat and trousers, and the woman is wearing a long, textured garment. Raindrops are visible around them, indicating inclement weather. The background includes vertical lines and shapes suggesting a city building or wall, with cobbled pavement under their feet. The image has a monochromatic tone.

artworks.title: Ah! docteur... je crois... que j'suis poitrinaire!
artworks.description: The image shows two men. One is seated, appearing relaxed, wearing a nightcap, a loose nightgown with vertical stripes, and is seated comfortably in a chair. The other man stands, leaning slightly forward with one hand on the chair's back. He wears a dark suit, fitted pants, a white shirt, and a high collar, and has short, dark hair. Next to them is a table with a pitcher and cup, while the background features a textured wall.

artworks.title: Un Mari brûlé du feu de la jalousie
artworks.description: This drawing shows an individual submerged in water beneath a tree, with a couple standing on a hill in the background. In the foreground, a person is partially submerged in water, clinging to a large tree trunk amidst the watery landscape. The water is depicted with rippling lines, and vegetation surrounds the edges. A top hat floats nearby. In the background, on an elevated hill, a couple is shown embracing or possibly dancing, partially obscured by atmospheric clouds. The scene conveys a sense of drama and contrasts the struggle in the foreground with the serene moment on the hill. The use of monochromatic tones creates a somber atmosphere.

artworks.title: C'est t'y a vous c'hien la?
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures in a park. One person is standing wearing a cloak and hat, holding out an object with multiple legs. The other person is seated on a bench, looking surprised and dressed in layered clothing. The background shows stylized trees. The artwork uses line and shading to create depth.

artworks.title: Les Temps sont durs...
artworks.description: The image shows two men walking side by side, engaged in conversation. The man on the left has short, curly hair, raised brows, and a faint smile. He wears a double-breasted coat and holds a cane. The man on the right wears a suit with a waistcoat, has one hand in his pocket, and wears a top hat. The background features a simple sketch of a landscape with hills or dunes.

artworks.title: Le Plus farceur de la société
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a person standing in front of a group of people who are pointing and gesturing. The central figure is holding a bottle and appears animated. The group on the right side is seated and engaged with the central figure. The background is textured with trees, creating a natural setting. The drawing portrays a moment of social interaction using precise linework and shading to convey emotion.

artworks.title: Moi aussi j'ai été jeune...
artworks.description: The image shows a person leaning over a balcony railing, with their upper body bent forward and resting on their forearms. The person has dark hair, a prominent nose, and furrowed brows. They are wearing dark, loose-fitting clothing. Below the balcony, two figures are walking away on a street. One wears a long coat and tall hat, while the other has their head covered with a possible bonnet. The background features an urban setting with multi-story buildings, chimneys, and a sense of depth.
